newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Sotto hits high ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Banco Sotto hits high ahead of results.

text.p: Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) hit a record high of 2,005 escudos on Tuesday as investors bet on the bank reporting a good set of results for the first half of the year.
The stock was up 70 escudos in volume of 192,500 shares. Traders expect the results after the market closes on Tuesday.
"There are orders for Banco Sotto based on hopes for the first half results. But I think that at 2,000 escudos or slightly below there will appear sellers," said one trader.

At 0856 gmt, the stock was at 1,990 having slipped below 1,980 briefly. However, another trader said that if the selling dried up, the stock could break back above 2,000 escudos given the fact that some investors were clearly looking for some excellent first half figures.
Banco Sotto posted a first half profit of 2.83 billion escudos in 1996 and a full year result of 11.97 billion.
